units.rawText: I heard you received quite a lot of complaints about me recently... It must have been tough. I can't help but want to tease those cute little brats on the street whenever I see them.

units.rawText: In truth, it's not as though I did anything too overboard; I simply told them about my experiences at Ultilife. But before I could finish, they'd run off crying and screaming.

units.rawText: (Sigh) It would be one thing if we were on the battlefield and I could channel my energy into other avenues, but the Oasis is so peaceful…

units.rawText: I will do my best to mind my behavior in the future and minimize any inconvenience to you.
